resources.string: Typing is processed on this device. Northern Tujia voice input sends recordings to an online third-party recognition service. Attaching keyboard actions is off by default.

Only when you use Northern voice input, your recording is sent to tujianlp-tujia-asr-demo.ms.show for recognition. Dictionary matching happens on this device. You may also copy or email a report yourself.
